ios.desc:
HouseTrak is the living binder for your home. Organize everything about your property in one place, from maintenance and renovations to vendors, documents, and asset history.

Keep your property on track with:
- Projects with budgets, statuses, and linked task lists
- Tasks with priorities, due dates, and drag-and-drop ordering
- Reminders with recurring schedules and email/SMS/in-app delivery
- Service contacts and vendor history for trusted pros
- Assets with model, serial, warranty, and barcode scanning
- Secure file uploads for receipts, inspections, and manuals
- Circuit panel mapping and lightweight floorplans
- Notes for quick, timestamped property records

Whether you own one home or manage multiple properties, HouseTrak helps you stay organized and prepared for what’s next.

quotes.text:
Hi HN — my wife and I built HouseTrak out of frustration.

Every time something broke or needed maintenance, the info was scattered: notes app, photos, emails, spreadsheets, reminders. There wasn’t one place to keep everything about our home.

So we built HouseTrak — a simple iOS app that keeps maintenance, projects, assets, and important home details in one place. One app for everything about your home.

It’s intentionally minimal and focused on being useful, not clever.

Would love feedback, especially from homeowners:

How do you currently track home maintenance?

What’s missing from tools you’ve tried?

App: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757889785
Site: https://housetrak.app

Thanks for taking a look.
